# Data Pipeline Research Note 4

Prior research on comparable products shows data pipeline handling of lineage interacts with compaction; teams noted that streaming depends on watermark and transform, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm data pipeline handling of ingestion interacts with dedupe; teams noted that consumer depends on offset and orchestrator, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that data pipeline handling of retry interacts with backfill; teams noted that latency depends on throughput and shard, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that data pipeline handling of staleness interacts with checkpoint; teams noted that sink depends on idempotency and schema, especially under real production load.
